title: Dropbox Brand Guidelines
promptLanguage: Break a chapter sentence into display lines, then let one control restyle a type specimen while a wide photograph sits beside a short color name. Keep the swatches, icons, and rules as real text in an uneven editorial grid.
notes: The chapters read as a brand book you can play: stacked display lines, a type treatment control, color names locked to photographs, and icons that change on hover. A strategy chapter mixes a short clip with document stills and four numbered cards, and the logo chapter uses the mark as the plane that starts the layout.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion leaves the display lines, specimen, swatches, icons, and photographs fully readable and skips the restyle and shuffle.
